description: 我希望你帮我查一下最新的论文，看看在这种 AI 可穿戴设备（比如耳机、眼镜）上面，摄像头都能用来干嘛，做什么应用。我主要想看那种不是直接调用产品原有摄像头，而是额外硬件添加摄像头的方案的
message: 调研完成：12 篇论文已写入 papers.json
negative_patterns: VR headset displays without earphone/glasses form factor
touch/gesture on earbuds without additional modality (tap controls only)
pure audio speech processing without extra sensing modality
eye tracking without EEG/EOG/camera/acoustic modality addition
constraint_terms: camera OR EEG OR EMG OR EOG OR ExG OR ECG OR acoustic sonar
